verse.verse_1: By the heavens and that which comes in the night --
verse.verse_2: and what could make you know what it is that comes in the night?
verse.verse_4: [for] no human being has been left unguarded.
verse.verse_5: Let man reflect on what he was created from.
verse.verse_6: He was created from spurting fluid,
verse.verse_7: issuing from between the backbone and the breastbone:
verse.verse_8: He certainly has the power to bring him back to life.
verse.verse_9: On the Day when secrets are disclosed,
verse.verse_10: [man] will have no power, and no helper.
verse.verse_12: by the earth cracking open with new growth.
verse.verse_13: It is surely a decisive utterance;
verse.verse_14: and is not to be taken lightly.
verse.verse_17: so bear with those who deny the truth, and let them be for a little while.
